description: Update an existing memory. Use supersede=true to create a versioned replacement (preserves history chain). Use supersede=false (default) to update fields in place.

content.description: New content. For in-place update (supersede=false): replaces content directly. For supersede=true: used as fallback if new_content is not provided.

id.description: ID of the memory to update

meta.description: Metadata fields to merge into existing meta JSON

new_content.description: Content for the superseding entry (used only when supersede=true). Falls back to `content` if omitted.

supersede.description: When true, creates a new entry that supersedes this one (preserves history). When false (default), updates fields in place.

name: memory_update
